Policy & Governance Subcommittee Agenda 

DATE: June 25, 2026 

TIME: 6:00 pm 

LOCATION: Zoom Only 

On March 29, 2025 Governor Maura Healey signed into law bodies to H.62, as amended by S.2506 (which contains the final form of the bill), entitled “An act Relative to Extending Certain Covid-19 Measures Adopted during the State of Emergency” (“ACT). Of interest to all governmental public bodies in Massachusetts, the Act extends until June, 2027, the authority for meetings of multiple-member bodies to be held in an entirely remote or hybrid format. All public bodies may hold fully remote or hybrid meetings, without the physical presence of a quorum of the public body, as long as “adequate, alternative means” of public access is also provided. 

Members of the public can access the meeting here:  

https://hps-holyoke-ma-us.zoom.us/j/85287777627

Or by phone by calling (301) 715-8592 and then providing Meeting ID Web 852 8777 7627. No passcode is required.
